# Philly Panic Index

> A daily index, on a scale of 0 to 100, of fan panic surrounding Philadelphia's four major professional teams: the Eagles (NFL), Phillies (MLB), Sixers (76ers, NBA) and Flyers (NHL). A new "official print" is published most mornings at 5:00 AM ET. The tone is satirical but the arithmetic is real and documented. It measures panic, not team quality, and it is not a forecast, a win probability or betting advice. Not affiliated with any team or league.

## Latest official print: Nov 28, 2026, 5:00 AM ET

- Citywide PPI: 54.8, down 0.8 from the prior print
- Market status: CONCERNED
- Eagles (NFL): 70.6, unchanged; city weight 50.0%
- Phillies (MLB): 58.4, unchanged; city weight 10.0%
- Sixers (NBA): 15.8, down 1.8; city weight 25.0%
- Flyers (NHL): 64.4, down 2.7; city weight 15.0%
- Primary panic driver: The Sixers clinched their first NBA Cup knockout berth with a 111-87 win; the Flyers beat Vancouver 5-2 while Matvei Michkov sat for violating team rules.
- Page for this print: https://phillypanic.com/prints/2026-11-28.html
- Official prints on record: 90, from Aug 31, 2026 to Nov 28, 2026. Range: high 80.8 (Oct 12, 2026), low 29.6 (Sep 2, 2026).

## How it is calculated (PPI Algorithm v1.2)

- Each team panic score is a weighted sum of six components, each scored 0 to 100: Performance 30%, Expectations vs Reality 20%, Stakes 15%, Injuries & Roster News 15%, Fan & Media Sentiment 10%, Historical Trauma 10%.
- The citywide reading is the sum of each team score times its city weight. The weights total 100% and follow the sports calendar.
- Market status bands for the citywide reading: 0-19 PARADE CONDITIONS; 20-34 WE'RE FINE; 35-49 RESTLESS; 50-64 CONCERNED; 65-79 HIGH ANXIETY; 80-89 WOODER BOILING; 90-97 FIRE EVERYBODY; 98-100 CIVIC EMERGENCY.
- If a day's reading is missing or unverified, nothing is carried forward; the site shows the last official print with its date.
